name: Office Perks
source:
You arrive in Westview Heights having just landed your first real job as a video game developer. Sure, you've made some awesome prototypes in your own time, but this is a chance to work with an established game studio and put your mark on it as the lead developer.

However, things take a quick turn not too long after starting and all of a sudden you have some serious decisions to make about your future, and maybe even the future of the friends you've made.
translation:
刚刚拿下人生第一份正式电子游戏开发工作的你，满怀憧憬地来到了西景高地。诚然，你此前在业余时间里独立做出过不少出色的游戏原型，但这一次，你将有机会加入一家成熟的游戏工作室，以主程序员的身份大展拳脚。

然而入职没过多久，事态便急转直下——转眼之间，你不得不为自己的未来，甚至是你新结识的朋友们的未来作出重大抉择。
